headline: {N} Tomcat workers stuck on socket I/O
detail: These http-nio-* workers are blocked inside sun.nio.ch or java.net.SocketInputStream.read. The TCP read is waiting on bytes that haven't arrived — most often an upstream HTTP/database call that's slow or unreachable. The workers are holding their Tomcat thread until the read times out (which can be many minutes if the connector's connectionTimeout is high).
remediation: Identify what these workers are calling: trace the stack down past sun.nio.ch into your code. Apply timeouts to whatever client library you use (RestTemplate.setReadTimeout, OkHttp.readTimeout, jdbc.url params, etc). A correctly-configured 5-second client timeout converts a hanging worker into a fast 500 response and frees the pool to handle the next request.
